title: Achiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (Biblical namesake: Achiya son of Achituv the priest—1 Samuel 14:3.) A great Babylonian scholar and leader of the exiles in Chananyah’s time—Chananyah being Rabbi Yehoshua’s nephew at Nehar Pekod, as in Berakhot 63b. Very likely he is the Rabbi Achiya of Moed Katan 20a whose son died in the Diaspora and for whom he observed seven days of mourning. The Gemara first sought to identify him with Rabbi Chiyya, then distinguished Chiyya from Achiya. Zevachim 48b has Rabbi Achiya, while Menachot 56a reads Rabbi Achiyah.

notes.text: The Biblical parenthesis supplies a namesake reference, not an identification with the later Babylonian scholar. Hyman’s proposed equation with Achiya in the mourning account remains tentative.
